finding: SH1000 isaA disruption altered transcript/protein profiles, with many increased purine-biosynthesis genes/proteins.
limit: Indirect biological association is not assignment of IsaA as a catalytic purine enzyme or a current KEGG member.

finding: Biochemistry and mutants establish QoxABCD as an aa3-type menaquinol terminal oxidase supporting aerobic respiration.
